steps.en: Install the desktop app; have a coding-agent CLI on PATH or a BYOK model key
steps.zh: 装桌面版；本机有编码 agent CLI，或备好 BYOK 模型 key

steps.en: Detects the agent CLIs on PATH and loads skills, templates and 151 design systems
steps.zh: 探测 PATH 上的 agent CLI，载入 skill、模板和设计系统

steps.en: On Home, pick an artifact type and a design system, then type a brief
steps.zh: 在首页选产物类型和设计系统，写一句需求

steps.en: Runs your agent in the project folder with the template and DESIGN.md composed in
steps.zh: 在项目目录里启动你的 agent，把模板和 DESIGN.md 拼进上下文

steps.en: Renders the files it writes in a sandboxed live preview
steps.zh: 把写出的文件渲染进沙箱里的实时预览

steps.en: Critique in chat until it looks right, then export
steps.zh: 在对话里挑毛病直到满意，然后导出

value.en: On-brand prototypes, decks and videos as real files on your disk, made by the agent you already pay for
value.zh: 符合品牌规范的原型、deck 和视频，以真实文件留在你的磁盘上，由你已经在用的 agent 产出

sources: https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design README Quick start (desktop app auto-detects every coding-agent CLI on PATH, loads skills, templates and 151 design systems)

README Product tour (Home: artifact type, brief, design system, working directory, model) and Architecture (daemon spawns the CLI in the managed project cwd; composes skill/template + DESIGN.md; sandboxed iframe preview)
README Decks section (export to HTML, PDF, PPTX, ZIP, Markdown) and Platform Compatibility (BYOK proxy when no CLI is installed)
